description: Uses one of the plan's daily backtests: ask the user before calling, then pass confirm: true. Queue a backtest of a saved strategy (strategy_id) or an unsaved spec over [from, to) (ISO dates, at most 366 days), optionally with explicit re-rank cuts. Answers with the queued run; poll polyrank_get_backtest. Results are SIMULATED (each report names its fill model and measured optimism). Counts against your plan's daily backtests. Needs POLYRANK_API_KEY.

confirm.description: Required: true, and only after the user agreed to this call in the conversation.

name: polyrank_run_backtest
title: Strategy Lab: run a backtest
